parameters.emailMessage/Subject: Approval process error - File locked by another user - @{triggerBody()?['entity']?['fileName']}
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Hello,

The Approval process failed because the file @{triggerBody()?['entity']?['fileName']} is currently locked by this user: @{split(split(outputs('Check_out_file')?['body']['message'], '|')[2], '@')[0]}.

Please contact the user or try again later. Thank you.

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: The approval request has timed-out for @{triggerBody()?['entity']?['fileName']}
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
The Approval request you initiated has timed out. Please cancel the Approval request and re-initiate.

Approval start date: @{convertTimeZone(triggerOutputs()?['headers']['x-ms-user-timestamp'], 'UTC', 'Central Standard Time', 'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm tt')} (in CST)
File: @{triggerBody()?['entity']?['fileName']}
Library: @{variables('Library')}
Approver(s): @{variables('Approver1Email')}; @{variables('Approver2Email')}

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: Approval not sent - @{items('Validate_each_approver')} cannot be an approver
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Your approval request for @{triggerBody()?['entity']?['fileName']} was not sent.

The approver @{items('Validate_each_approver')} is not an active employee or contractor (the account is disabled, a service or shared account, or otherwise outside the approval eligibility group).

Please start the approval again from the Legal Manager Library and choose a different approver.

inputs.name: ApproverValidationReason
inputs.value: The approver @{items('Validate_each_approver')} is not an active employee or contractor (the account is disabled, a service or shared account, or otherwise outside the approval eligibility group).

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: Approval not sent - @{items('Validate_each_approver')} could not be resolved
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Your approval request for @{triggerBody()?['entity']?['fileName']} was not sent.

The approver address @{items('Validate_each_approver')} did not resolve to exactly one user account in the directory (@{length(body('Exact_mail_match'))} matches).

Please start the approval again from the Legal Manager Library and choose a different approver.

inputs.name: ApproverValidationReason
inputs.value: The approver address @{items('Validate_each_approver')} did not resolve to exactly one user account in the directory (@{length(body('Exact_mail_match'))} matches).

runError.message: @{variables('ApproverValidationReason')} The approval was not sent and the requester has been emailed. Please start the approval again and choose a different approver.

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: Approval not sent - no approver set on @{triggerBody()?['entity']?['fileName']}
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Your approval request for @{triggerBody()?['entity']?['fileName']} was not sent because no approver is set on the document.

Open the document's details pane, set First Approver (and Second Approver if a second is needed), then start the approval again.

The approver list offers active employees and contractors only.

inputs.name: ApproverValidationReason
inputs.value: No approver is set on @{triggerBody()?['entity']?['fileName']}. Open the document's details pane, set First Approver (and Second Approver if a second is needed), then start the approval again.
